engine._autostart_mode_note: Retained for schema compatibility and ignored: boot is always Paper. Setting it to 'live' does nothing. Live is an operator action taken at the dashboard against a running process, so that neither a redeploy nor a crash-restart can put an unattended box into Live.

_assets_note: The wallet trades btc/eth/sol/xrp and nothing else — 184 of 654,200 scraped rows touch any other slug. Assets outside this set have no measured basis.
_strategy_note: 1:1 behavioural replication of Polymarket wallet 0x3c58ef422754ff22c7e806336feba0064d8b776b (@antsaslyku). Every value is measured from a complete scrape of its public history: 654,200 activity rows over 113 days (2026-04-24 to 2026-08-15), 569,015 fills, 85,001 redemptions, $4,190,784 turnover, 101,541 windows reconstructed end-to-end to a known winner. See polybot/strategy.py for the derivation of each number.

strategy._timing_note: First fill lands p10 7s / p50 53s / p90 291s into the window; the earliest observed in 101,652 windows was 2s. Entries run the full length of the window and first-fill ROI is HIGHEST in the last decile (+16.19%), so max_entry_window_fraction is 1.0 rather than the 0.5 the old directional profile used.
strategy._price_note: The wallet buys at price p and wins at p+0.03, consistently, from 0.05 to 0.75. The edge is +0.054 at its best (0.05-0.10) and reaches zero at 0.80-0.85 (-0.002) and above (0.90+: -0.007). Replayed on its own entries with flat $5 clips, the 0.02-0.85 band returns +3.50% over 98,742 windows.
strategy._max_model_edge_note: The single most important safety gate. Our probability and the book's price are two estimates of the same quantity; when they disagree by tens of points the near-certain explanation is a broken spot feed, not a 50x mispricing of a five-minute window. The wallet's largest measured edge across 101,541 windows was +0.054, so anything past 0.25 is rejected as implausible rather than traded.
strategy._sizing_note: Median fill is $5.04 — and it is $5.04 at EVERY ladder position from the 1st fill to the 26th. There is no escalation in this wallet, no Kelly and no bankroll fraction. (An earlier build of this repo modelled a $60 'escalation clip' at fill 8; that was an artefact of a 16.8h sample and is measurably false over 113 days.)
strategy._price_scaled_clip_note: The $5 clip applies at ORDINARY prices only. Measured median fill size by price paid, across all 569,015 fills: under 2c $0.05, 2-5c $1.20, 5-10c $1.54, 10-20c $3.05, then $5.00-$5.06 from 30c up. The wallet stakes dust on longshots. Cloning it with a flat $5 clip is a ~100x over-size in exactly the band where the position usually expires worthless — observed 2026-08-15, a flat clip bought 467 shares at 1c three times and lost every one.
strategy._min_order_note: The venue's orderMinSize is FIVE SHARES, not five dollars. The dollar minimum therefore moves with price: $0.05 at a cent, $3.00 at 60c, $4.25 at 85c. This is why the wallet shows $3.65 and $4.17 fills — they are ~5-10 share orders, not partial fills.
strategy._ladder_note: Mean 5.6 fills/window, median 3, p90 13, max 391. Second same-side fill lands a median 21s after the first; 56.5% of add-ons go in above the prior fill and 33.8% below. Measured ROI by cap on the first side: 1 fill +2.69%, 2 +2.72%, 3 +2.56%, 5 +2.22%, uncapped +2.02% — so 2 is the profit-maximising setting and 40 is the faithful one.
strategy._window_mix_note: 86.3% of the wallet's fills are on 5m and only 13.7% on 15m ($3.76M vs $0.43M). It entered 82,677 distinct 5m windows against 18,975 15m ones — a 4.36:1 ratio — averaging 5.94 fills per 5m window against 4.11 per 15m. Three times as many 5m windows exist per hour, so equal entry rates already give ~3:1; the rest comes from entering a higher fraction of 5m windows (69% vs 47% on btc). Without these two caps, 15m positions stay open three times longer, sit on the open-exposure budget and starve the 5m windows that carry most of the wallet's activity.
strategy._hedge_note: OPERATOR DECISION 2026-08-15: enabled to reproduce the wallet literally. 52.0% of its windows open a second leg, a median 66s after the first fill. The two legs together cost a median $1.042 and only 35.6% of its 52,816 hedges came in under $1.00 — so this is NOT arbitrage; buying a pair above $1.00 books a loss at the moment of the fill. Holding entries fixed, the full ladder+hedge returned +2.05% on $4.19M where the first side alone returned +2.02% on $2.73M: the hedge buys 5.9x the capital for the same return per dollar. Set hedge_enabled=false, or hedge_max_combined_cost=1.0 to admit only genuine locks.
strategy._exposure_note: The wallet's own envelope: peak 8 concurrent windows, cost per window median $19.28 / p90 $96.43 / max $2,418.53, turning over a median $33,667 a day. These are the outer bound only — the mandatory bankroll controls below are applied afterwards and are what actually binds at a small balance.
strategy._execution_note: Every one of the 569,015 observed fills is a taker BUY and there is not a single SELL: positions are held to resolution and redeemed. usdcSize/(shares*price) averages 1.0245, consistent with this venue's shares*rate*p*(1-p) taker fee — which confirms every ROI quoted here is already fee-inclusive.

_limits_note: Caps applied by the engine after the strategy has decided what it wants, and which the strategy cannot raise.

bankroll._note: Mandatory in both Paper and Live. These are the controls that actually bind: the wallet being cloned runs a median $19.28 per window against a balance far larger than this one, so at this bankroll the clone's ladder will be truncated here rather than by max_fills_per_window.

live_market_selection._note: Disabled by operator choice: Live may trade every asset/window that Paper may trade. Historical paper rankings remain visible for comparison only.

sizing._note: Dashboard sliders. base_clip_usd on the strategy is what the clone actually stakes; these are the ceilings the sliders enforce on top of it.

depth_guard._comment: Roughly 5x the $5 clip. The upstream repo's 250 assumed far larger sizing and would exclude most of this venue's short-window books.

risk._trade_floor_note: The venue's orderMinSize is FIVE SHARES, not five dollars, so the real dollar floor moves with the price: $0.05 at a cent, $4.25 at 85c. The old $5 figure treated a share count as a dollar amount, which both blocked every legitimate cheap entry and forced a 100x over-size on longshots. The strategy computes the true per-price minimum itself (see min_stake_for); this is only the absolute backstop.

_fees_note: Read from the live CLOB V2 market feeSchedule: fee = shares * rate * (price * (1-price)) ^ exponent, TAKERS ONLY. Makers pay nothing. At 50c and rate 0.07 this is 1.75c/share (3.5% of notional). Confirmed against the scraped wallet: usdcSize/(shares*price) averages 1.0245.
